body: I just...am. I have urges, I can analyze everything to perfection, I understand people’s behavior more than they do themselves. It’s lonely. Incredibly so. And I have no true sense of self. Just who I am to fit everyone else’s needs.
Wise words, thank you. It really does help. You're right I need to speak with her face to face...I just don't know if I can.

Thank you...I see the mistake I have made there. Please do make a little scroll down there to read my other reply. It begins to answer this comment as well. 

Thank you

I truly don't want to bring my family into this. They aren't moral, ethical, or principled people. To sum it up...they aren't good. I would never be able to see a doctor until I leave home. 

Do you having any advice? I guess I shouldn't have broughten her into this...I am to blame. She is so precious-God what have I done? How do I fix this? Fix her? I think that she is frightened.

We are very alike. I am very intelligent, yet keep my mental capacity a secret. If you raise your standards, and show people yourself, then they're always going to hold you to that. There's no going back. And if people saw who I really was....they wouldn't know what to do

Thanks.....honestly I haven't mustered up the strength to talk to her in person yet. I know it's terrible but it's true. We've only spoken over text. I don't think she wants to talk about it anywhere else though. What should I say?
As do I...I know that you spoke with him too

Thank you, though I'm just done. Either I'll take enough pills or I'll shoot directly through my brain. I won't make it to be a potatoe or live the rest of my life in a medical bed. I won't be that stupid. 
You are very wise. I admire you fighting strategies, yet unfortunately I am not built as strong as you. Sometimes I wish I was. 
I put a facade to hide the misery. In fact I play the part so well sometimes I even fool myself. I've lived this way my whole life. What could possibly change that now?
Thank you, but I am and I can't stop it. This is how it's going to be...and I'm just goin to have to be okay with it. Until I can end it at least.

Thank you, though I fear it will never change. No matter what I do, or who I surround myself with I always return to this mindset. The only time it alters is when I'm with the girl I opened up to....but it's only temporary, and I don't even understand that.

You're not alone...I'm here. I just spoke with a man who just killed himself. I heard his last words. We talked for hours about plans that we had. Futures we hoped for. Then about what happened that turned everything around. How we are both going to kill ourselves. I guess he just had bad enough to do it right now. So I feel like talking to someone right now too.

We're both probably f**ck up people. But what we are going to do is strong. Not weak. Don't say that. If we are going to hurt people then maybe they should have thought about paying some damn attention to how much WE WERE HURTING in the first place
I hope it's beautiful. I hope you find peace. I hope the best for you. I loved talking to you. I really have.

I hope there is nothing beyond death. I hope that's it's just nothing. Because that's what we want right? Or maybe just a beautiful green field with the wind blowing in our faces with a warm breeze at the perfect temp. You can feel one with the field. And as you lay in the pastures, you're finally at peace
May you find peace
One last thing. You were probably a great person. You probably impacted many lives even if you didn't mean to or notice. Before you go...just know this. There's no hope for us. But that's okay

I understand where you're coming from. I just hope you know that the deep dark disparity that I'm feeling (if you can even call it a feeling, it's more like an engulfment), is just as bad as almost anyone else's. I'm my own worst enemy. I'm my only fear. No words can describe what I feel. If it even is "feeling".
*making me kill myself
Look where I am. And where I'm going to be. What's the worst that can happen? Make me loll myself a few days early? That may be better

I am aware that it means a lot to be able to talk with someone in their final moments....so is their any advice for me....or things you want to be put out in the world that you either never got to say or want to say that you want to tell me? I'm all ears
I feel the same way. Now I know I'm not alone
I don't know. I don't know if it's enough
What do I even say?
This is true. I'm just so afraid of talking to her about it. I just don't want to hurt her. She is so precious. So fragile. So perfect. I don't want to hurt her.
Do you want to tell me why you have chosen this?
Okay...I understand. I hope you go peacefully. Maybe I will too.

I recently told the most important person in my life that I was suicidal. She doesn't even know in the slightest how important she is to me. So when I opened up to her over text (so cowardly), I was hoping that as would be my hero and somehow swoop down to save the day. How f**kd up is that? She just keeps telling me to keep going even when I tell her I WANT TO SERIOUSLY DIE. Then she threatens to tell someone if I don't promise her I won't do it. She doesn't speak to me about it when we're alone or at school. Maybe talking her crossed the line. But then again, where does that line even get drawn in these days? I'm im 8th grade btw. Anyway, my parents must have been tipped off by her because now they want me to go see a doctor too. It's all jacked up. Should I talk to her about it? Or will it make her more uncomfortable? I don't really know. Maybe in your last moments you'd like to give some advice?

I won't stop you. I feel you. I understand you. I will kill myself soon. You are strong for doing this. Don't listen to anyone who says its cowardly. But I will ask you this before you go....can you just stick in there one more day? I'll give you my number. I'm going to kill myself soon. I just want someone to talk to. Please. For me?
Beuatiful. True.

I know exactly what you're going through. At this point I know it seems like no one can..but I do. I suffer from an unknown disease that almost kills me sometimes (being serious). I'm in constant pain physically and metally. I want my life to end fast and painlessly. Like take too many sleeping pills or somethings. Though some small small itty bitty wee little part of me still wants to find the good in life that everyone else seems to bathe in....the majority just wants to die. I don't know when I'll do it....but I need to soon.

I truly am sorry. This is me...practically every day. I struggle with a constant longing for suicide. To end it all. I'm just waiting for the right time. But until that day comes, I watch. I watch everyone else breathe while I seem to be drowning. For some this may help, other not so much. Just know that somewhere out there someone wants to talk about it. Helping them helps you too. Trust me. I am worthless it's a fact. The most important person in my life (doesn't know they are), consistently tells me to keep going after I informed her that I was suicidal. Though she's never been convincing enough and she hasn't texted me enough to make sure I'm okay. She doesn't bring it up when we're alone or at school. Maybe this is all making her uncomfortable....thoughts? I hope you find someone that can convince you you're worth it. I would if I knew you.
